notes: This file contains derived annotations, not copied transcript text or publisher audio.
Scores are editorial fast-play suitability indexes, NOT measured percentages of active play or rules time.
The English YouTube caption tracks are auto-generated, contain transcription errors and overlapping cue times.
Caption samples were inspected in consecutive ten-minute windows across each recording; no claim of line-by-line manual listening.
Scores for episodes with no checked captions remain provisional and are capped below specifically reviewed fast-play episodes.
